title: Crumb: how does an AI agent get a logged-in browser for a saved account?
scope: Running crumb launch: agent guard, CLI, detached supervisor, Chrome, the encrypted vault, OS key store and target sites.

groups.label: Agent host
groups.description: Local coding agent (Claude Code/Codex) and its hook

groups.label: Local crumb processes
groups.description: Local self-hosted Node processes, Chrome and ~/.crumb state

groups.label: OS services
groups.description: Local OS keychain / Secret Service holding the vault key

groups.label: Websites
groups.description: External third-party sites the account belongs to

nodes.label: Coding agent
nodes.description: Asks for a session via crumb CLI, then drives the browser

nodes.label: Vault guard
nodes.description: Blocks agent tool calls that mention ~/.crumb or CRUMB_HOME

nodes.label: crumb CLI
nodes.description: Short-lived command; spawns supervisor and waits for its handle

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.description: Detached process: launches Chrome, injects state, autosaves

nodes.label: Chrome
nodes.description: System or Playwright Chrome with a local DevTools port

nodes.label: Session vault
nodes.description: Encrypted sessions, profiles and run handles under ~/.crumb

nodes.label: OS key store
nodes.description: Keychain or secret-tool holding the vault key (or file/env)

nodes.label: Target sites
nodes.description: Websites using the injected cookies and storage

notes.title: Autosave and stop
notes.text: Supervisor snapshots storage every 30s by default, on SIGUSR2 (crumb sync) and on SIGTERM (crumb close), merging changes into the vault. A failed autosave is only logged.

notes.title: Startup handshake
notes.text: CLI polls for the run handle (pid + CDP URLs) for up to 60s; supervisor writes an error file on failure, else CLI reports 'did not start'.

notes.title: Key fails closed
notes.text: If the vault exists but its key is missing from keychain/secret-service/CRUMB_KEY, crumb throws KEY_UNAVAILABLE instead of creating a new key.
